patch.summary:
Choose Clearbit only if your buying job matches “HubSpot-owned enrichment (Clearbit → Breeze Intelligence) for CRM fill and inbound intelli” rather than RocketReach's shape. Choose RocketReach only if your buying job matches “B2B contact database for finding professional emails, phone numbers, and company insights ” rather than Clearbit's shape. Workflow advantage: Clearbit leans data-enrichment, contact-management; RocketReach leans prospecting. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Clearbit is HubSpot-owned enrichment (Clearbit → Breeze Intelligence) for CRM fill and inbound intelligence — usage/credits via HubSpot, Starter+ requir; RocketReach is B2B contact database for finding professional emails, phone numbers, and company insights with prospecting automations..
- Workflow coverage skew: Clearbit-leaning data-enrichment, contact-management vs RocketReach-leaning prospecting.
- Researched limits: Clearbit — Now HubSpot-owned and repositioned as Breeze Intelligence — buying motion is HubSpot-centric; RocketReach — Not a CRM pipeline/deal manager..

Limitations — Clearbit: Now HubSpot-owned and repositioned as Breeze Intelligence — buying motion is HubSpot-centric; No standalone free plan; typically needs HubSpot Starter+; RocketReach: Not a CRM pipeline/deal manager.; Essentials is email-only; mobile/direct phones require Pro+..

Poor-fit cases: Clearbit is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Now HubSpot-owned and repositioned as Breeze Intelligence — buying motion is HubSpot-centric · RocketReach is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a CRM pipeline/deal manager. · Avoid Clearbit if you actually need RocketReach's motion (B2B contact database for finding professional emails, phone numbers, and company)
